page.overview:
Who is Killkhan?

Killkhan is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

Killkhan is an overweight giant with green semi-long hair, a green mustache, a large double chin, and a button nose. He wears a spiked metal helmet which hides his eyes, a chainmail tunic, and a cape attached with suspenders.

Killkhan appears to be gluttonous as he carried a piece of meat into combat. As a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates, he does not shy away from combat, and was willing to fight to defend his homeland. However, when the likes of their MMA relatives attacked the giants, Killkhan, like everyone else, admitted that he did not have the guts to fight against them. Like other giants, he admires Nika.

As a giant, Killkhan possesses superhuman strength and resistance.
